virtual-network-manager-subscription-bil.title: Older Virtual Network Manager instances can switch to per-virtual-network billing
virtual-network-manager-subscription-bil.body: This estimate bills Virtual Network Manager per subscription, the default for instances created before the virtual network-based model. Microsoft says these instances can opt in to per-virtual-network billing, which may cost less when few networks per subscription are managed. Compare both.

citation.quote: Users of this billing method can opt-in to use Virtual network-based billing.
